title: 游戏目标与引导缺失
description: 游戏缺乏明确目标、战斗和最终目标，故事线缺乏引导，导致玩家感到不完整和缺乏参与感。
evidence: once you get to the point to of buying derelicts to flip you have pretty much beaten the game. There are other late game things you can do, but there isn't as much engagement there
you don't even get any nudge gameplay wise to follow storylines, they just 'happen' at best or are missed entirely.
No lead in/short tutorial for ship v ship combat.

evidence_items.quote: you don't even get any nudge gameplay wise to follow storylines, they just 'happen' at best or are missed entirely.
evidence_items.description: 缺乏引导玩家跟随故事线的游戏机制
evidence_items.quote_zh: 在玩法上你甚至得不到任何引导去跟随剧情线，它们充其量只是'发生'了，或者被完全错过。

evidence_items.quote: this title does not have a real endgoal, not even optionally, leaving the title in a less complete feeling state forever
evidence_items.description: 游戏没有真正的最终目标，甚至没有可选目标，导致永远感觉不完整
evidence_items.quote_zh: 这款游戏没有真正的最终目标，甚至没有可选目标，让这款游戏永远处于一种不够完整的状态

evidence_items.quote: No lead in/short tutorial for ship v ship combat.
evidence_items.description: 舰对舰战斗缺乏引导或简短教程
evidence_items.quote_zh: 舰对舰战斗没有引导/简短教程。

evidence_items.quote: once you get to the point to of buying derelicts to flip you have pretty much beaten the game. There are other late game things you can do, but there isn't as much engagement there
evidence_items.description: 购买废弃船只翻新后，游戏后期内容缺乏参与感。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 一旦你到了购买废弃飞船来翻新转卖的地步，你基本上就已经通关了。你还可以做其他后期的事情，但那里的参与度就没那么高了

evidence_items.quote: there is no combat, no objectives, nothing except fixing up a ship and getting it running
evidence_items.quote_zh: 没有战斗，没有目标，除了修好一艘船并让它运转起来之外什么都没有
